Slack conversations in `/desk-slack` now read like Slack: formatted text, code blocks, links, date lines, grouped messages, attachments, and terminal tables redrawn to fit the pane.

- Messages were plain text with Slack's markup left in (`*bold*`, ```` ``` ````, `&gt;`, `Files: …` lines). They are now drawn with desk-look's Markdown renderer: bold, italic, strikethrough, code blocks (also when opened and closed on one line), clickable links, mentions, `•` lists, quotes and rules
- A date line marks where the day changes, the time next to a name is the clock time, and messages one person sends within 5 minutes share one name line
- Attachments show as `📎 name · size`
- Code pasted without a fence keeps its indentation, and text copied from a terminal (every line after the first indented the same) is un-indented so its lists and rules line up
- A table pasted from a terminal (drawn with `│` and `─┼─`) is rebuilt, joining the rows the terminal had wrapped, and redrawn to fit the pane, or as one card per row when the columns would cut words
- The conversation list and notifications no longer show raw ```` ``` ```` or `&gt;`
- desk-look's Markdown renderer gains two options for this (line breaks kept, cards for narrow tables), off by default, so Claude's replies look the same

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-asana@cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-slack@cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
